meta.source: MCCNS Visual Identity Guidelines, November 2020 (PDF, 9 pages)

tokens.name: mcc-navy
tokens.usage: Primary colour. PMS 282 C · CMYK 100/60/15/75 · RGB 0/29/62. Headings, body text, header/footer bars and the preferred ground for reversed logos. Text on it: `on-dark` (16.9:1) or `mcc-yellow` (11.1:1). Never `mcc-cerise` on it (2.4:1).

tokens.name: mcc-light-blue
tokens.usage: Primary colour. 30% tint of PMS 282 C · CMYK 30/18/5/22 · RGB 144/157/178. Backgrounds and panels only; the standard logo may sit on it. Text on it: `mcc-navy` (6.1:1) or black (7.7:1). Never white (2.7:1), `mcc-yellow` or `mcc-cerise` text on it. The 2020 guideline prints its HEX as #D9DDE2, but its RGB, CMYK and drawn swatch are this value — treat #D9DDE2 as a misprint.

tokens.name: mcc-yellow
tokens.usage: Secondary colour. PMS 116 C · CMYK 0/20/100/0 · RGB 255/203/5. Accent (~10%): highlights, key figures, the spear divider, headings on navy (11.1:1). Text on it: `mcc-navy` (11.1:1). Never as text on `surface` (1.5:1) or `mcc-light-blue`, and never white text on it.

tokens.name: mcc-cerise
tokens.usage: Secondary colour. PMS 220 C · CMYK 30/100/60/10 · RGB 166/33/77. Accent (~10%) and one of the two mono-logo colours. Text on it: `on-dark` (7.1:1); `mcc-yellow` for bold headings only (4.7:1). As text: on `surface` (7.1:1). Never next to or on `mcc-navy` without a white or yellow separator (2.4:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default page and slide ground (~60% with `mcc-light-blue`). Standard logo sits on it. Text on it: `ink`, black or `mcc-cerise`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Default text and headings on `surface`, `mcc-light-blue` and `mcc-yellow`.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text, the white reversed logo and the white SCS endorsed logo on `mcc-navy` or `mcc-cerise`.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Mono logo and SCS endorsed logo option; acceptable body text in Word documents and letters on `surface` (21:1) or `mcc-light-blue` (7.7:1).

styles.name: major-heading
styles.usage: 16pt / 18pt leading. Garamond Semibold, ALL CAPITALS, 100 tracking (0.1em). Major headings only — use sparingly. Size assumed; the guideline sets no absolute sizes.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: 14pt / 16pt leading. Gotham Medium; all capitals or upper and lower case. Leading 2pt above size (guideline rule). Size assumed.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: 12pt / 14pt leading. Gotham Medium; 2pt above body copy size (guideline rule).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: 10pt / 12pt leading. Gotham Book, left aligned, leading 2pt above size (guideline rule). 10pt base assumed.

styles.name: office-heading
styles.usage: 14pt / 16pt leading. Helvetica Bold — Word, PowerPoint, letters and emails when Gotham isn't available. Never on external material.

styles.name: office-subheading
styles.usage: 12pt / 14pt leading. Helvetica Bold, 2pt above body size.

styles.name: office-body
styles.usage: 10pt / 12pt leading. Helvetica Regular (Oblique for emphasis), left aligned, leading 2pt above size.

tokens.name: logo-min-horizontal
tokens.usage: Minimum width of the horizontal logo, in mm.

tokens.name: logo-min-vertical
tokens.usage: Minimum width of the vertical logo, in mm.

tokens.name: crest-min
tokens.usage: Minimum width of the crest only (full or one colour), in mm.

tokens.name: scs-logo-min-horizontal
tokens.usage: Minimum width of the Sydney Catholic Schools endorsed logo (horizontal), in mm; always 50% of the school logo's size.

tokens.name: scs-logo-min-vertical
tokens.usage: Minimum width of the SCS endorsed logo (vertical), in mm.
